about_the_game:
Enter a world where Muay Thai meets the pages of a comic book. Muay Mayhem blends fast-paced martial arts action with bold, colorful visuals, a dynamic combat system, and a splash of cartoony comedy that brings every strike to life.

Create and customize your fighter, then test your skills in tournaments, challenge modes, and real-time online battles. Master devastating combos, time your strikes perfectly, and unlock powerful abilities—all while dodging a few laughs along the way.

Whether you're brawling with friends on the couch or clashing with rivals online, Muay Mayhem delivers a chaotic, laugh-out-loud experience for fighters of all skill levels. With explosive gameplay, outrageous character moments, and eye-popping comic book flair, this isn’t just martial arts—it’s a full-blown smackdown with style and a sense of humor.

Note: The game itself is in English. The Steam page may or may not be available in other languages.

content_descriptors.notes: Muay Mayhem is a competitive fighting game that recreates ring and cage matches inspired by the martial art of Muay Thai. It features stylized hand-to-hand combat, including punches, kicks, elbow and knee strikes, and knockouts. While there is no graphic gore, the game contains animated violence and intense physical action that may not be suitable for all audiences.

short_description: Step into a living comic book where every strike snaps, every combo cracks, and every elbow tells a story. Muay Mayhem is a fast-paced martial arts fighting game that blends authentic Muay Thai with comic-inspired visuals, bone-rattling action, and a splash of cartoony comedy.
